entity.name: Luna's Eat & Drink
entity.address_line_1: 25689 Canal Rd Suite B, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA

entity.editorial_summary: Easygoing, family-friendly bar & grill with Southern dishes, craft beers, TVs & a roomy patio.
entity.description: Easygoing, family-friendly bar & grill with Southern dishes, craft beers, TVs & a roomy patio.

items.name: Crab and Artichoke Dip
items.description: Blue crab and artichoke hearts baked with Swiss and Parmesan cheeses. Served with grilled pita bread.

items.name: Beer Cheese Dip
items.description: A creamy blend of swiss, cheddar, and dark beer. Served with soft pretzel bites.

items.name: Fried Onions
items.description: Shaved thin and lightly fried. Served with comeback sauce.

items.name: Pimento Hushpuppies
items.description: Fried, fluffy, and delicious. Served with house-made blueberry pepper jelly.

items.name: Whisker Nuggets

items.name: Crab Claws
items.description: Gulf blue crab claws lightly floured and fried.

items.name: Creole BBQ Gulf Shrimp
items.description: Sautéed in herb-scented Worcestershire butter. Served shell-on with toasted garlic bread.

items.description: Lightly dusted bay shrimp fried and tossed in spicy remoulade sauce.

items.description: Buttermilk and hot sauce brined chicken breast battered, fried, and dipped in our hot glaze. Served on toasted buzzcatz white bread with shredded lettuce, pickles, and garlic Parmesan sauce.

items.name: Mac-n-Cheese
items.description: Cavatappi pasta, oven baked in a rich cheese sauce, and topped with seasoned bread crumbs.

items.name: Luna's Tropical Splash
items.description: Coconut rum, muddled fresh strawberries, & mint mixed with house-made sour mix

items.name: Pirate Punch
items.description: This tasty blue cocktail is made with captain morgan spiced rum, coconut rum, blue curacao, pineapple juice, & a splash of orange juice

items.name: Espresso Martini
items.description: Sweet and rich. This delicious pick me up combines Absolut vodka, coffee liqueur, & simple syrup with fresh brewed buzzcatz espresso

items.name: Luna's Margarita
items.description: A local favorite! Made with our house-made sour mix & lunazul blanco. Topped with gran gala

items.name: Moscow Mule
items.description: Tito's handmade vodka, spicy ginger beer, & lime juice garnished with a lime

items.name: Creamy Coconut Margarita
items.description: Lunazul silver, triple sec, lime juice, & cream of coconut. Rimmed with toasted coconut and topped with gran gala

items.name: Mango Mama
items.description: Cruzan mango rum, dark rum, pineapple juice, orange juice, & a splash of grenadine

items.name: Pink Sunset
items.description: As refreshing & vibrant as a summer sunset. Crafted with deep eddy's lemon vodka, raspberry simple syrup, muddled lemon, & mint. Topped with pink lemonade and a splash of lemon lime soda
